title: BattleReadyShelf Model Definition Export
description:
The authoritative contract for the JSON document accepted by POST /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/import (and produced by GET /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/export). This is the canonical source of truth for this contract - other repositories producing an import document (e.g. battlereadyshelf-dataset) must conform to it. It mirrors the 'ModelDefinitionExport' schema in backend/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml; if the two ever disagree, the OpenAPI spec wins and this file should be updated to match.

This is the last of the three definition documents to import. It only references factions and wargear by their stable ids - see faction-export.schema.json and wargear-definition-export.schema.json, which are imported from their own admin pages first. An id this document references that does not exist yet fails the import, naming the page to import it from.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this export document's schema. Must be within the backend's supported range (see ExportSchema) or the import is rejected. All three definition documents share one version.

exportedAt.description: Set by the backend on export; ignored if present on import.

datasetVersion.description: Optional version of the source dataset assembled into this document.

factions.description: DEPRECATED - import factions from the Manage Factions page instead. Still accepted so an older combined catalogue keeps working; never emitted by an export.

wargear.description: DEPRECATED - import wargear from the Manage Wargear Definitions page instead. Still accepted so an older combined catalogue keeps working; never emitted by an export.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this model definition across imports instead of by name. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored definitions emit the persisted UUID instead. Names need not be unique - different games may reuse a model name.

factionId.description: The stable id of the faction this model belongs to. It must already exist (import the faction document first). Null if uncategorised.

id.description: Stable identifier for this slot, used to match it across imports and by wargear slot references. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored slots emit the persisted UUID instead.

type.description: Stable machine-readable category for this physical attachment slot.

wargearOptionExportItem.description: One model's use of a shared wargear definition: which slot(s) it fills on this model and whether it is part of the default loadout. The item's name lives on the wargear definition, not here.

id.description: The stable id of the wargear definition this option uses. It must already exist (import the wargear document first).

name.description: DEPRECATED - the name lives on the wargear definition. Only read from an older combined catalogue that defines wargear inline; never emitted by an export.

isDefault.description: Whether this option is part of the model's default loadout.

slotIds.description: The id(s) of the attachment slot(s), from this same modelDefinitionExportItem's 'attachmentSlots', this option fills.
